hub.speaker: A Villager
hub.text: They take a beat too long to look at you. "The hens are laying again. No. That weren't your question. Everyone keeps asking after me."

text_variants.text: So that's what that was. I keep losing the thread of it. I meant to say something. It's gone again. Thank you. Them beans went in crooked last month. Been staring at the rows all morning.

remember.speaker: A Villager
remember.text: Pieces. A price I said yes to. Never read the terms, none of us did. There was a voice in my mouth for weeks and it weren't mine. I should be angry. I keep meaning to be angry.

options.text: For what it's worth, I'm glad it's over.
